product_name: Moonlit Potting Shed: Adult Halloween Colouring Book

style_reference.shared_prompt: Original adult colouring-book pen-and-ink artwork in a refined cosy-gothic botanical style; crisp confident black outlines, organic hand-inked curves, varied line weight and delicate controlled crosshatching. High-detail yet highly colourable forms, balancing intricate engraved textures with generous open spaces; pure black on white, no grey shading, fills or gradients. Calm, intimate, quietly enchanted autumnal mood, clean home-printable line art.
style_reference.line_weight: Clean confident outer contours with fine-to-medium interior lines and occasional heavier focal accents.
style_reference.line_quality: Crisp, deliberate, hand-inked linework with gently organic curves, controlled hatching and tidy decorative embellishment.
style_reference.detail_level: High but colourable detail: intricate surface patterns and small decorative accents balanced by broad open areas for relaxed colouring.
style_reference.shading: No solid black fills, grey tones or digital gradients. Build depth selectively with sparse crosshatching, stippling and parallel contour marks, always leaving ample room to colour.
style_reference.background_density: Layered, moderately dense backgrounds that frame the focal area without filling every space; use calm open pockets throughout.

canvas.format_notes: Single-sided portrait colouring pages with a clear print-safe border and balanced open areas for comfortable adult colouring.

pages.title: Moonlit Potting Shed
pages.scene: Illustrated title cover introducing the moonlit potting-shed garden theme.
pages.composition: A rustic potting bench spans the lower half of the page beneath an arched shed window. A carved pumpkin lantern sits centrally among herb jars, seed packets, terracotta pots, hand tools and trailing vines. Through the window, a full moon hangs above an enclosed walled kitchen garden with climbing plants and distant pumpkins. A vintage seed-packet label at the top carries the title, with a small subtitle beneath.
